    Local structure of string diagrams #

    At a position j of a word of length n, the letter j - 1 (if j > 0) and the letter j (if j < n) are the incident edges. The left letter points into j when it is direct and out of j when it is inverse; the right letter points out of j when it is direct and into j when it is inverse.

    • next_eq_some_iff: arrow moves are exactly these edges (for words without forks).
    • injMoves: arrow moves of a string are injective.
    • inCount, outCount: numbers of incoming and outgoing edges, with inCount + outCount = [j > 0] + [j < n].
